reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's document family changed: index record 21 is a Reserve Account Report carrying an independent limited-assurance conclusion under SPA 3000 from Crowe Teramihardja, Pradhono & Chandra (report 0008/TPC-AS/TBD/26, signed November 6, 2026), replacing the monthly agreed-upon-procedures series. The report body states a cut-off of October 29, 2026 at 14:12 WIB on every page; the file name and index record say October 28, and the body date is used. Its seven balances are ORI030 Rp4,005,850,153; Bank Ina Rp2,074,897,149; Bank Nationalnobu Rp6,551,295,287; Bank Mandiri Rp606,033,655; Duitku Rp1,028,760,993; PINTU Rp998,811,267; and Indodax Rp746,751,938. They sum exactly to the stated Rp16,012,400,442 reserve assets against 15,874,022,396 IDRX in circulation, an excess of Rp138,378,046. Weights are each exact balance divided by that denominator without rounding. Versus September 30, no Bank Rakyat Indonesia balance is reported, so its slice is removed; Nationalnobu rises from Rp67,784,983 to the largest bank balance; Bank Ina falls to Rp2,074,897,149; Mandiri rises to Rp606,033,655; the ORI030 balance is unchanged. Report criteria measure ORI030 at market price at the cut-off. The ORI030 slice keeps only the conservative July 15, 2032 latest documented series maturity, now 2,086 calendar days from the October 29 snapshot; the report does not identify the held tranche, and this is a contractual worst-case maximum, not a tranche identification, weighted-average maturity, rapid sale guarantee or final settlement bound. The accountant compared contract addresses with published addresses, observed banking and platform dashboards, and obtained a GHP Consulting Pte. Ltd. balance statement for the ORI030 account, consistent with the existing custody profile. Report circulation enumerates Polygon, Celo, Base, BSC, Kaia, Solana and Lisk; the registry also lists gnosis, etherlink and worldchain deployments, so the enumeration is not established as a complete current multichain liability census. Neither the report nor account balances establish realization horizons, so no immediate-liquidity assumption is carried.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Seven institution/instrument balances in the October 29, 2026 limited-assurance Reserve Account Report complete reserve table, divided by Rp16,012,400,442
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All seven reported reserve balances are identified. The ORI030 exact tranche and underlying depository, enforceable segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation protections and stressed realization horizons are not established, and report criteria measure ORI030 at market price at the cut-off. Only a conservative maximum over the documented ORI030T3/T6 contractual maturities is known. A report-complete reserve table is not a complete current liability census.
